native_reference_unavailable.scan: No equivalent macOS command measured; scan.py separately compares native POSIX and bulk APIs without process startup.
native_reference_unavailable.volumes: No equivalent macOS command measured; diskutil disk inventory has different semantics from cached mounted filesystems.

notes: Current installed StallionFS release and Apple plain-output references; prior-release controls are omitted.
Fresh subprocess wall time includes startup and completed operation; CPU includes harness and reaped child time.
Each case uses deterministically shuffled paired rounds, retaining every sample and warmup.
Setup, output validation, checksums, mode/inode checks and cleanup are outside timing.
Warm caches; no durability flush, large fixture, new volume, or asynchronous cleanup.
Apple references are cp -cRp, mv -n and rm -f on an absent exact destination or existing regular file.
JSON file-command comparisons reuse the measured Apple plain-output case: they are unpaired across output cases and do not include JSON formatting in the reference.
Those controlled cases do not establish equivalent overwrite, cross-volume or general command semantics.
The requested store path must remain absent throughout; no workspace is prepared.
Runtime/source paths, mount paths, owners and command output are validated locally and omitted from this report.

paired_plain_effects_method.cpu: cpu_children_s is completed-command user plus system CPU, excluding benchmark-runner CPU.
paired_plain_effects_method.difference: Apple minus StallionFS within the same measured round; positive values favor StallionFS.
paired_plain_effects_method.interval: Distribution-free two-sided order-statistic confidence interval for the median paired difference, assuming independent rounds. Coverage is at least 95%; repeated host conditions can correlate rounds.
paired_plain_effects_method.memory: Memory is measured separately; these effects do not establish a memory advantage.
paired_plain_effects_method.scope: Plain single-file cases only. JSON commands use an unpaired plain Apple reference and are excluded from this paired analysis.

average_cpu_cores_method: Median/min/max of per-sample command cpu_children_s / wall_s excluding warmups. Wall includes startup; CPU excludes the runner. Average occupied cores are not peak or machine-wide utilization. Missing CPU makes the summary unavailable; Apple scan/volumes/JSON cases were not measured.

report_scope.selection: All current-release and Apple samples, including warmups and losses, are unchanged. Only prior-release control rows and summaries are omitted.
